digest.title: Hackers breach Microsoft 365 tenants via ConnectWise supply-chain attack
digest.tldr: ConnectWise has shut down customer access to its Cloud Backup service (formerly SkyKick Cloud Backup) after hackers accessed application identities and compromised Microsoft 365 tenants.

digest.title: Replit makes OpenAI its default over Anthropic, CEO says
digest.tldr: Over the weekend, Masad clarified that OpenAI would replace Anthropic as its default model provider.  Claude will still be available to customers on the platform.

digest.title: ConnectWise Suspends Cloud Backup After Attackers Compromise Microsoft 365 Tenants
digest.tldr: ConnectWise on Saturday said it has disabled seven ConnectWise application identities as it continues its investigation into an incident in which unknown threat actors obtained unauthorized access to the application…

digest.title: RTX Spark Ignites Global Celebration as New Windows PCs Arrive
digest.tldr: NVIDIA RTX Spark laptops are now available, bringing NVIDIA Blackwell RTX graphics, up to 128GB of unified memory and the full NVIDIA AI platform to slim, premium Windows PCs.

digest.title: Meta removes language that raised scraping and AI training concerns
digest.tldr: A Meta spokesperson insisted that the updated terms did not reflect a change in the way Meta crawls the web.
